test_timedelta_range: test the timedelta_range function to create a TimedeltaIndex with specified start and periods
test_Index_append: test the Index.append method to append a non-timedelta index to a TimedeltaIndex
test_Index_join_outer: test the Index.join method with how='outer' to join two TimedeltaIndex objects
test_Index_join_preserves_freq: test that TimedeltaIndex.join preserves the freq attribute when joining contiguous slices
test_Index_join_does_not_convert_mixed_i: test that Index.join does not convert mixed integer dtypes when joining DataFrame columns with index
